interface.signature: s1: str, n1: int, s2: str, n2: int -> int

preconditions.description: The integer n1 must be between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.
The integer n2 must be between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
Both strings s1 and s2 must have a length of at most 100 characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum integer M such that [S2,M] can be obtained from S1.
